selector.rationale: The patient's presentation of a painless, gradually enlarging vulvar mass extending into the inguinal region, along with ultrasound findings of a well-defined, hypoechoic solid mass tracking into the inguinal canal, strongly supports Canal of Nuck hernia, especially given the lack of contradictions and strong supportive evidence.

rejected.label: Bartholin gland cyst
rejected.why: Contradicted by evidence, such as the location and characteristics of the mass, which do not align with typical presentations of Bartholin gland cysts.
